description: CUBIT-Det is an image dataset for detecting visible defects in buildings, pavements and bridges. Benyun Zhao and collaborators publish 5,527 images acquired in 2023, with bounding-box labels for cracks, spalling and moisture. Documented image sizes are 4,624 by 3,472 and 8,000 by 6,000 pixels. The public Google Drive release lists image and label folders plus training, validation and test split files. Geographic acquisition coverage is not established by the repository. Access is free and the explicit dataset statement applies CC BY 4.0 to images, annotations and metadata. A limitation is that bounding boxes describe visible defects, not calibrated structural capacity or failure probability. The newer project website describes a larger benchmark and physical-quantification tasks; those expanded counts are not substituted for the named CUBIT-Det release. Simulation uses include developing condition-assessment inputs and evaluating inspection detection uncertainty. No related catalogue resource was identified as a direct dependency. The Drive directory was inspected without downloading images, and the reported annotation quality and detection scores were not independently tested.
